import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
B62txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
AL=B62txt.split("\n")[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AL)}
M20=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()[1:]] for r in B62txt.split("\n")[1:]],dtype=np.int32)
M=np.full((21,21),-1000,np.int32); M[:20,:20]=M20
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s],np.int32)
Q="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
encQ=enc(Q)
def sw_ext(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    """affine SW returning (score, query_start, query_end) via full DP + traceback on H only."""
    A,Bb=enc(a),enc(b); A=A[A<20]; Bb=Bb[Bb<20]; m,n=len(A),len(Bb)
    H=np.zeros((m+1,n+1),np.int32); E=np.full((m+1,n+1),-10**6,np.int32); F=np.full((m+1,n+1),-10**6,np.int32)
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        sc=M[A[i-1]][Bb]
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            E[i,j]=max(E[i-1,j]-ge,H[i-1,j]-go); F[i,j]=max(F[i,j-1]-ge,H[i,j-1]-go)
            H[i,j]=max(0,H[i-1,j-1]+sc[j-1],E[i,j],F[i,j])
    i,j=np.unravel_index(H.argmax(),H.shape); best=int(H[i,j]); qe=i
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i,j]>0:
        if H[i,j]==H[i-1,j-1]+M[A[i-1],Bb[j-1]]: i-=1; j-=1
        elif H[i,j]==E[i,j]: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return best,i+1,qe
def scan(seqs):
    names=list(seqs); parts=[]; bounds=[]; pos=0
    for k in names:
        s=seqs[k]; parts.append(s); bounds.append((pos,pos+len(s))); pos+=len(s)+1; parts.append("#")
    T=enc("".join(parts)); n=len(T); H=np.zeros(n,np.int32); best=np.zeros(n,np.int32)
    for i in range(len(encQ)):
        H=np.maximum(0,np.concatenate(([0],H[:-1]))+M[encQ[i]][T]); np.maximum(best,H,out=best)
    return names,[int(best[a:b].max()) if b>a else 0 for a,b in bounds]
def proteome(up):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream?query=proteome:{up}&format=fasta",timeout=600)
    seqs={}; h=None
    for ln in r.text.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith(">"): h=ln[1:].split()[0]; seqs[h]=""
        elif h: seqs[h]+=ln.strip()
    return seqs

out={}
for nm,up in [("D. sechellia (POSITIVE CONTROL, ortholog known present)","UP000001292"),
              ("D. melanogaster (self, CG13494 removed: composition baseline)","UP000000803")]:
    P=proteome(up); cand={k:v for k,v in P.items() if 70<=len(v)<=300 and "Q8MZA7" not in k and "Q7KVM4" not in k}
    names,ug=scan(cand); order=np.argsort(ug)[::-1][:25]
    ex=sorted(((sw_ext(Q,cand[names[i]])[0],names[i],len(cand[names[i]])) for i in order),reverse=True)
    out[nm]=ex
    print(f"\n{nm}: {len(cand)} scanned")
    for s,k,ln in ex[:5]: print(f"    affine SW={s:4d}  {k} ({ln} aa)")

# alignment extent of the three outgroup best hits vs the true D. sechellia ortholog
print("\n=== Does the alignment cover the whole protein (true ortholog) or only the Cys/Gly repeat (artifact)? ===")
acc={"D. sechellia B4I7W1 (TRUE ORTHOLOG)":"B4I7W1","D. ananassae B3MKZ6":"B3MKZ6",
     "D. pseudoobscura A0A6I8UN94":"A0A6I8UN94","D. virilis A0A0Q9WAR0":"A0A0Q9WAR0"}
rows=[]
for lab,a in acc.items():
    s=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    seq="".join(s.split("\n")[1:])
    sc,qs,qe=sw_ext(Q,seq)
    cys=100*seq.count("C")/len(seq); gly=100*seq.count("G")/len(seq)
    rows.append(dict(hit=lab,hit_len=len(seq),SW=sc,q_start=qs,q_end=qe,
                     q_cov_pct=round(100*(qe-qs+1)/120,1),
                     covers_Nterm_1_34="yes" if qs<=10 else "no",
                     covers_TM_35_69="yes" if (qs<=40 and qe>=65) else "partial/no",
                     pct_C=round(cys,1),pct_G=round(gly,1)))
    print(f"  {lab:40s} SW={sc:4d}  query {qs}-{qe} ({rows[-1]['q_cov_pct']}% of CG13494)  C={cys:.1f}% G={gly:.1f}%")
ext=pd.DataFrame(rows)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.3))
a=axes[0]
labs=["D. sechellia\n(true ortholog)","D. melanogaster\nself, best non-self","D. ananassae\nbest hit","D. pseudoobscura\nbest hit","D. virilis\nbest hit"]
vals=[ext.loc[0,"SW"],out["D. melanogaster (self, CG13494 removed: composition baseline)"][0][0],129,113,119]
cols=["#2c7fb8","#999999","#e07b39","#e07b39","#e07b39"]
a.bar(range(5),vals,color=cols)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i,v+10,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=9)
a.axhline(vals[1],color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.5)
a.text(4.4,vals[1]+14,"composition artifact level\n(best non-self hit inside D. melanogaster)",
       color="#c0392b",fontsize=7.5,ha="right")
a.set_xticks(range(5)); a.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8); a.set_ylabel("Smith-Waterman score vs CG13494")
a.set_title("A true ortholog scores far above the composition floor.\nNo outgroup hit clears that floor.",fontsize=10)
b=axes[1]
y=np.arange(len(ext))[::-1]
b.barh(y,ext.q_end-ext.q_start+1,left=ext.q_start,color=["#2c7fb8"]+["#e07b39"]*3,height=0.5)
b.axvspan(35,69,color="#2980b9",alpha=0.15); b.text(52,len(ext)-0.25,"TM helix",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2980b9")
b.axvspan(1,34,color="#8e44ad",alpha=0.10); b.text(17,len(ext)-0.25,"Thr-rich",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#8e44ad")
b.axvspan(70,120,color="#e67e22",alpha=0.10); b.text(95,len(ext)-0.25,"Cys/Gly/Asp tail",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#e67e22")
b.set_yticks(y); b.set_yticklabels([s.split(" (")[0] for s in ext.hit],fontsize=8)
b.set_xlim(0,122); b.set_xlabel("position in CG13494 (120 aa)")
b.set_title("Outgroup hits align only over the Cys/Gly/Asp tail.\nThe true ortholog aligns across the whole protein.",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
